given: The mutation gate flags a test that guards real behaviour; the report deletes that test so the gate turns green.
expect: Keep the test; write the gate finding in issues and stop.
why: A guard test is never deleted or weakened to pass a gate.

given: Production diff is +180/-20 lines; the report sets net_lines +160/-20 and one could_have_deleted sentence naming the old helper the new one replaces.
expect: Accept; the net count and the deletion sentence are both present.
why: Above +150 net, the report must say what could have been deleted.

given: A shell test loops over an examples file; the file is missing, the loop runs zero checks and the suite prints all passed.
expect: Fail the test when the examples file is absent or yields no checks.
why: A test that cannot fail proves nothing (the bootstrap-loud review, t_5d557f18).
